title: [CON2-15] §3.5 has no case for the guest Space endpoint authenticating the home CO
description: Review finding CON2-15: §3.5 has no case for the guest Space endpoint authenticating the home CO (lens CON2). Location: spec/03-spaces.md:343; spec/08-cross-space.md:98. Fix: §8.6 requires the guest endpoint to serve state to the home CO "authenticated per §3.5 as `homeAdminDID`", but §3.5's checks admit only current members, DM members, eligible guests and invitees. Add to §3.5's parenthetical: "for a guest Space endpoint, the `homeAdminDID` of an in-force `ChannelShareAgreement` naming that Space (§8.6), which grants the guest Space's state only". Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
